onb.welcome.title: Welcome to Expertmotion
tour.1.body: Home is text, Design is looks, Tools is generators. The left panel changes with each.
tour.1.title: Three places to work
tour.2.body: Drop clips, images and audio here. Number them with the badges, then press Insert to put them in the timeline. The sample's three clips are already in.
tour.2.title: Your assets live here
tour.3.body: Hover a card to try it on your video in the player; click to pick it. Each pick lands in the Intent Queue as a receipt: simple picks apply directly with no AI, and a second pick strikes the old one through instead of losing it.
tour.3.title: Preview, pick, keep a receipt
tour.3.try: Try it: click a card to pick it.
tour.4.body: Each lane is a track: video, overlay, text, captions, audio. Click any element to inspect it; your next picks then apply to it.
tour.4.title: Everything on the timeline
tour.4.try: Try it: click an element on the timeline.
tour.5.body: The Brainstorming Agent helps with ideas and structure. It never changes your video; it proposes, and you decide what to send on. Try: "judul pembuka yang energik".
tour.5.noprovider: Connect a provider from the Model Bar to try this.
tour.5.title: Think out loud here
tour.6.body: The Editor Agent turns requests into a plan: steps, what will change, and any risks. Read it, add a note if you like, then press Execute. Only then does the video change, and you can undo it.
tour.6.sample.label: Example plan
tour.6.sample.note: Connect a provider to see a real plan for your video.
tour.6.sample.plan: Add title 'Kafe Senja' 0–3 s · Rise motion
tour.6.title: Nothing changes until Execute
tour.7.body: Pick the platform shape (width:height) and resolution; the exact pixels are shown. Performance profiles change how much of your PC is used, never the video. Private Mode here stops every internet connection; editing and export keep working.
tour.7.private.on: Switch Private Mode off to keep using the agents in this tour.
tour.7.title: Shape, size, speed, privacy
tour.8.body: Export checks disk, memory and size first, then renders on this PC with progress and cancel. Your file lands in the project's output folder.
tour.8.title: Export when you are ready
tour.done.body: That is the whole loop: insert, pick, describe, Execute, export. Help ▸ Tour brings this back any time.
tour.done.title: Tour complete
tour.preparing.failed: The sample project could not be prepared. You can take the tour on this project instead.
tour.rerun.title: Re-run the tour on this project or the sample?

ui.scr.about.gpl: Source offer: the espeak-ng phonemiser (GPL-3.0-or-later) and the compositor FFmpeg build (GPL-2.0-or-later) run as separate programs and are not linked into Expertmotion. For at least three years after this release the publisher provides their complete corresponding source code on request; write to the support address on the purchase page.
ui.scr.about.limitations.body: Export preflight does not analyse your footage for flashing content. Reordering and trimming on the timeline arrive in a later update.
ui.scr.about.security: How your data is protected: project storage is encrypted and tied to this Windows account, and provider keys are encrypted again on top. These protections raise the cost of extraction or misuse; none of them protects against the owner or an administrator of this computer with a debugger, a patched program or a compromised operating system. To move projects to another account or computer, use Backup and Restore.
ui.scr.about.notices.body: Expertmotion uses open-source components, including Remotion (company licence), React and FFmpeg. The voice engine includes GPL-licensed parts; the source offer is in the installation folder.
ui.scr.about.notices.file: Full licence texts: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt in the installation folder.
ui.scr.about.remotion: Videos are rendered on this computer with Remotion under the Remotion License held by the publisher of Expertmotion. You do not need your own Remotion licence, and Expertmotion never runs code you bring.
ui.scr.about.title: About

Faster profiles need more RAM and a GPU; the video itself is identical: frame rate and output size never change. Standard works on every computer. Accelerated needs tier T1 or T2. Turbo is meant for T2; on T1 it works but may not be faster (EM-3106).
